source: CDM small-scale (SSC) thresholds. TYPE-LEVEL caps (15 MW / 60 GWh-yr / 60 ktCO2e-yr) confirmed against the CDM Project Standard / SSC modalities (UNFCCC, web-verified 2026-06-03). Per-category Type-I caps from CDM SSC modalities; entries flagged "verify" (thermal I.C/I.E = 45 MWth) to be confirmed against "General guidelines for SSC CDM methodologies" CDM-EB66-A23-GUID v25 (cdm.unfccc.int; site behind Incapsula -> fetch via browser). Public regulatory thresholds = prediction-blind. SSC caps reconciled 2026-06-03 vs CDM-reg_stan04_v03.0 v03.0: 2 confirmed, 0 conflict.
scale_fit_logic: Sibling pair {large ACM/AM, small AMS-X}: given extracted PDD capacity C and AMS-X cap T -> C<=T => small(AMS) eligible; C>T => AMS ineligible => large variant. SOFT signal unless C is high-confidence (per adversarial review: no hard-exclude on low-confidence extraction). NOTE: resolves SCALE axis only; registry-variant (same-scale) is NOT disambiguated by SSC caps.
